external_theorem.name: Schaefer dichotomy for Boolean CSP/SAT(Gamma)
external_theorem.source_bound_statement: For a finite Boolean constraint language Gamma, SAT(Gamma) is polynomial-time decidable when Gamma is 0-valid, 1-valid, Horn, dual-Horn/anti-Horn, bijunctive, or affine; otherwise SAT(Gamma) is NP-complete.
external_theorem.modern_source: Jonsson, Lagerkvist, Osipov, CSPs with Few Alien Constraints, CP 2024, Theorem 2, DOI 10.4230/LIPIcs.CP.2024.15
external_theorem.original_source: Thomas J. Schaefer, The Complexity of Satisfiability Problems, STOC 1978

proof_target.C3_not_Horn: EVEN_XOR3 is not closed under coordinatewise AND: 011 AND 101 = 001, which is excluded.
proof_target.C4_not_dual_Horn: EVEN_XOR3 is not closed under coordinatewise OR: 011 OR 101 = 111, which is excluded.
proof_target.C5_not_bijunctive: EVEN_XOR3 is not closed under coordinatewise majority: majority(011,101,110)=111, which is excluded.
proof_target.C6_not_affine: OR2 is not closed under ternary minority/XOR: 01 XOR 10 XOR 11 = 00, which is excluded.
proof_target.C7_Schaefer_classification: By the source-bound dichotomy, SAT({OR2,EVEN_XOR3}) is NP-complete.
proof_target.C8_connected_reduction: Any Gamma-CSP decomposes into variable-incidence connected components. If every connected Gamma instance were solvable in polynomial time, solving all components independently would solve arbitrary Gamma-CSP in polynomial time.
proof_target.C9_algorithmic_implication: Therefore a polynomial exact connected-wide message/carrier mechanism covering every connected instance over these two relations would imply SAT(Gamma) in P and hence P=NP. This is an implication, not a proof that no such mechanism exists.

mandatory_firewalls.BARRIER_MEANING: Do not treat unrestricted connected composition of individually tractable carriers as routine polynomial glue. Additional structural restriction or a genuine P-vs-NP breakthrough is required.
